posts.cooked: Normally, I don’t participate in cosplay. Given my social anxiety, I really don’t wear anything beyond jeans, white shoes, blank shirt, and a hat. However, I’ve been invited to a friends birthday party, and she requires everyone that attends to be dressed up. Anyone not dressed up with be refused. She has given a cheap way out by just wearing cat ears, but even that makes me anxious. Does anyone have any ideas of something to wear, that if at a cosplay event, would appear I’m dressed up, but outside of such an event, I would appear normal (or at least as normal as I am able to appear). Also, something cheap, as I really don’t want to spend a lot of money on a one time thing.
